title: The Library Stays Open
text: Since March, the school library in Bandung has stayed open until seven in the evening, and the change has surprised almost everyone. title: A Novel of Salt and Rain
text: 'The Boat That Waited' tells the story of Nurma, a girl who inherits her father's fishing boat and refuses to sell it. The first half of the novel moves slowly, and readers who want action may lose patience. I nearly did. text: If your laptop has become slow, do not buy a new one yet. title: Keep the Subtitles
text: Every few months someone proposes that foreign films on our television should be dubbed rather than subtitled. I disagree, and not only for artistic reasons. title: Counting Birds Before Breakfast
text: Since 2021, students at three schools in Sleman have counted birds in the same six gardens on the first Saturday of every month. They begin at six o'clock and watch for fifteen minutes, writing down only what they can identify with certainty. The data are not perfect, and the students know it: new observers often miss small birds high in the branches. One pattern, however, has appeared clearly. In gardens where the owners stopped cutting the grass short, the number of species has risen by about a third. Two university researchers now use these records, and they say the value of the project lies in its regularity rather than in the skill of any single observer.

title: A Job at Seventeen
text: Some parents believe that a student who works on Saturdays is a student who will fail. My own experience suggests the opposite, though not for the reason people expect. Eight hours a week in a small bakery did not teach me business; it taught me that time is finite. Once I had lost Saturday, I stopped wasting Tuesday. I do not pretend that this works for everybody. A friend of mine took a job of thirty hours a week, and her marks collapsed within a single term. The number of hours matters far more than the principle. If schools discussed that number honestly with families, fewer students would have to choose between money and study in silence.
